claims.drop: Nicholas Singleton (22, RB, TEN dc3 — 1.4 wk / 64 season, zero offensive snaps in week 3)
claims.why: JimmySC was chopped after week 3 (65.5) and his whole roster went to waivers this morning: Taylor (20.8 wk / 272 season under this league's full-PPR scoring, IND dc1, the best RB available in any of the eight leagues), Egbuka, Odunze, Henderson, Pitts, Love, Stafford, plus Caleb Williams/Breece Hall/Dowdle who are all Out. Daily waivers, clear_days=1, waiver hour 0 — the claims process at midnight tonight into Wednesday, so bids must be filed TONIGHT. Read live: 14/14, $1000 of $1000 unspent; the weakest starter is Woody Marks at 6.7 (20 of 54 Houston snaps), so Taylor is a +14/week lineup swing. SIZING — THIS IS THE ARGUMENT OF THE EDITION. The observed market for chopped studs is $388 (Nico Collins, wk1) and $407 (Puka Nacua, wk2): a bid that WINS Taylor outright is ~$451-501, and the weeks-1-6 'bid to win' rule would say pay it. Two things override that rule here. (1) Sal's guillotine rule from Monday's stream (new in expert_methods.md): save FAAB for the final rounds, when the chopped rosters are the strongest and the fewest bidders remain; bid 1-2% early even on stars, Taylor <=10%, UNLESS you are at chop risk. (2) The roster is not at chop risk: 114.9 this week was 5th of 15 (the chop line was lique11 at 77.9, a 37-point margin) and 331 points-for is 3rd overall. Money spent now buys +13/week on a margin that is already 37; the same money in weeks 12-17 buys studs against 4-5 rivals, half of whom are already spent (jcordoba $338 left, pitsonvillejags $600). $151 is 15%, above Sal's ceiling because this league's market has cleared absurdly low before (Emanuel Wilson went for $10 with the plan at $231) — a steal bid, not a win bid. If the user disagrees with the hoarding logic, the win price is $501 and the drop is the same. Drop Singleton: no offensive snap Sunday, no path to the lineup. | 9/29 evening: Sleeper wire confirms Singleton logged zero offensive snaps in week 3.

claims.drop: Zach Ertz (35, TE, PHI — 3.7 wk / 37 season; 19 of 50 snaps Sunday and Isaiah Likely is the TE with Ferguson likely out)
claims.why: De'Von Achane tore his ACL Sunday (season over, IR) and Gordon is now MIA's dc1. Usage says bell-cow sample: 61 of 73 offensive snaps (84%) with 17 carries + 3 targets and a TD — but that sample is the game Achane left early AND Jaylen Wright sat (stinger/foot, day-to-day), so it is the replacement role with the committee half missing. Sal's explicit ruling Monday: do NOT overpay for Gordon — bottom-5 offense (2.4 ypc Sunday), Hafley promising 'roles' for every back — and FF's rule that an 80%+ snap share does not transfer whole to the replacement. Both mechanisms check out against the snap log, so $51 (5%, top of the speculative tier) instead of role-bet money; hectorviov, who just dropped Achane and holds $861, will likely pay more and that is fine. Drop Ertz: with Ferguson likely out Likely starts at TE anyway and Ertz's PHI role (19 of 50 snaps, 1 catch) is a dead spot in a league where every spot must score. | 9/29 evening: FF (Ep. 1982 + short) expects 20%+ market bids but won't pay them — Wright stays involved, MIA implied total 13.5 (season low), @MIN/CIN then a bye. Confirms the sober $51; unchanged. | 9/29 evening: Ertz reverted to PHI's practice squad Tuesday — the drop is now free.
